changelog:
Initial release of the 七国群雄传 (Seven Kingdoms Tactics) strategy game skill.

- Launches a 三国群英传-style HTML5 isometric turn-based wargame directly in the preview, with no setup required.
- Supports Campaign and Skirmish modes; each mode offers single-player (vs AI), same-device Hotseat, and online Net Play (includes relay for cross-device multiplayer).
- Players can quickly start, learn with in-game tutorials, and share achievements and records.
- Hotseat and Net Play support full tactical battles with clear instructions for setup.
- Game features include combo chains, bond auras, co-op ultimates, general codex collection, achievements, and personal bests.
